string-array.name: how_to_add_ways
string-array.item: Hand: look at a card in Library, pinch
Controller: point at the card, pull the trigger

string-array.name: how_to_select_ways
string-array.item: Hand: look at the panel or its size tag, pinch
Controller: point at it, pull the trigger

string-array.name: how_to_move_ways
string-array.item: Hand: pinch the size tag and drag, drop near a dashed frame to snap
Controller: point at the size tag, hold the trigger and move

resources.string: Turn it, push it away, pull it closer

string-array.name: how_to_turn_ways
string-array.item: Hand: Adjust page, tap − / + on each row
Controller: stick left/right turns, forward/back pushes and pulls

string-array.name: how_to_rate_ways
string-array.item: Hand: on the Legibility page, pinch Clear / Barely / Can\'t read
Controller: point at the same keys, pull the trigger
